scope: Exploratory sensitivity specified after computing the original crossed outcome. Restrict to the same 26 frozen ranking-endpoint passes with interior coverage. Also show their fixed 16-member subset passing original guard endpoints. Membership never depends on alternative weights.
contrasts: Compare the observed point panel to the original strict majority using exactly the same rows, masks and predictions. This alters both weighting and aggregation.

On each row partition compare original to five new four-panel majorities. Keep the original point weights, draw three independent stratified bootstrap weight vectors at the same per-class sample sizes and masses. This changes only bootstrap weights, preserving the sum threshold and selected row IDs.

Use one unresampled point panel with equal within-class weights. Fix the class total masses to the averaged two original point panels on both row partitions. Changing row partition then changes cases, with the single-panel functional and class masses held fixed. This is an evaluation diagnostic, unrelated to learning or selecting a model.
random: SeedSequence([5119, archived seed, dataset index in primary factorial.json, partition index rank=0/guard=1, replicate index 0 to 4]); five new draws are repeated measurements, reported as a range or mean with each draw printed.
